result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Popular right now' card shows a loading spinner overlay stuck on top of an already-loaded restaurant image, which looks visually broken. Other elements (clipped carousel item, bottom-cut card) are expected scroll behavior and not defects.

issues.description: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now', a circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of an already fully-rendered food image. The image has clearly loaded, so the persistent spinner looks broken and confusing, as if the card is stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading spinner once the image finishes loading, or only show the spinner as a placeholder before the image is available. Ensure the spinner state is cleared on image load completion.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red indicator dot with no text alternative or badge count, which may not be perceivable by screen reader or low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 new') and consider a numeric badge or text cue in addition to the color-only dot.
